31 October 2026

Decision
--------
Do not retain the perpendicular quadrupole cold-carrier S/T cycle as the
primary capability once an arbitrary active source is optional. Preserve
its exact interaction, admission theorem, and source-uniform instrument as
research capital. For a prepared/calibrated apparatus, ordinary one-body
singlet-to-charge capture is a substantially stronger comparator than the
failed naive exchange phase pulse. It uses the same data orbitals, detuning,
charge sensor, OFF barrier, and triplet-preserving spin symmetry, while
avoiding the weak quadrupole coupling and fresh orbital carriers.

This is a scoped engineering decision, not a universal impossibility result
for collisional cooling or a claim that every exchange gate dominates every
weak capacitive interaction.

1. The linked geometric scaling
-------------------------------
Use the actual perpendicular geometry derived in
../phase3_fast_detector/COULOMB_ENERGY_CARRIER.txt. The data transition density
has a quadrupole Q_D; the helper energy doublet has a transition dipole d_H.
At separation R,

 lambda = (3C/2) Q_D d_H/R^4 + O(R^-6),
 kappa_static = -C Q_D/(2R^3) + O(R^-5).

For localized data wells, Q_D is proportional to their overlap S_D times
a_D^2. A helper energy doublet has d_H of order a_H without an additional
helper-overlap penalty. Ordinary data hopping has scale

 t_D ~ E_orb S_D,
 |lambda|/|t_D| ~ A [C/E_orb] a_D^2 a_H/R^4,             (1)

where A is a dimensionless orbital-shape factor. The SAME S_D cancels in
this ratio. Reducing data overlap therefore suppresses useful Coulomb
transfer and ordinary one-body transfer together. It does not make the
Coulomb route relatively faster. The exact finite-separation coefficients
in the previous work make this comparison quantitative.

SINGLET ERASURE FILTER: COMPARATOR AND NOISE-SCOPE AUDIT
31 October 2026

This is a complementary audit of the root construction. It distinguishes
established representation theory from the concrete exchange instrument,
and supplies counterexamples to stronger noise and recovery claims.

1. What was already established
-------------------------------
Bacon, Kempe, Lidar and Whaley, Universal Fault-Tolerant Computation on
Decoherence-Free Subspaces, PRL85,1758 (2000), explicitly identify the
four-spin singlet code as a distance-two code detecting arbitrary
single-spin errors. Their exchange entangler traverses the fourteen-
dimensional eight-spin global singlet space and returns to the product
of two local singlet codes. Exchange universality within singlet spaces
and protection during a global singlet excursion are established capital.
The continuous-time vector-selection observation below is a direct
corollary, not a defensible standalone novelty claim.
Primary: https://arxiv.org/pdf/quant-ph/9909058
Relevant locations: distance-two statement near equation4; encoded
controlled-phase construction near the end of the universal-gates section.

Heinz, Sharma and Kattemolle, Exchange-only qubit stabilized by a
single-spin qubit, arXiv:2608.14214 (2026), use a three-edge equal-exchange
star to transfer the three-spin gauge into an auxiliary spin. They also
measure XXXX and ZZZZ for a four-spin singlet-only code with two auxiliary
Loss-DiVincenzo spins, single-spin rotations, and flagged measurement
circuits. Their fault model includes arbitrary two-spin depolarizing
faults, and their specially constructed gate claims concern pi rotations
and swaps, not an established universal fault-tolerant gate set. This is
the closest direct prior use of the root filter's star ingredient.
Primary: https://arxiv.org/html/2608.14214v1
Relevant locations: II.1 equation1, II.2, II.3, IV.2 and IV.3.

There is therefore no claim that singlet encoding, error detection,
collective gauge transfer, or universal exchange control was discovered
here. The candidate contribution is an economical, exactly computed full
singlet-admission instrument assembled from those physical ingredients,
and the operations that can continue while it is applied.

ENERGY-SELECTIVE EXCHANGE LEAKAGE RESET: EXACT BLOCKS AND LIMITS
31 October 2026

Status and purpose
------------------
This complementary construction replaces the weak perpendicular Coulomb
carrier with ordinary exchange and a fresh singlet pair. It earns an
approximate reset of all four leaked spin projections of a three-spin
exchange-only qubit, preserves a commuting logical control axis, and gives
an exact obstruction to perfect reset by one constant edge. It does not
outperform calibrated reset-if-leaked sequences merely by taking a large
gap. The root investigation has therefore moved to a four-spin singlet
erasure filter; this note preserves the useful three-spin calculation.

1. Physical operations and full Hamiltonian
------------------------------------------
Let spins 1,2,3 be data and spins 4,5 a helper pair. Write S_i=sigma_i/2
and hbar=1. The data code has S_D=1/2 and dimension four (logical qubit
times gauge spin). The four-dimensional S_D=3/2 sector is leakage. An
equal antiferromagnetic exchange triangle has, up to a scalar,

 H_D=Delta P_L,   Delta=3 J_D/2,
 P_L=(S_D^2-3/4 I)/3.

The helpers are loaded as a singlet, have an adjustable positive singlet-
triplet splitting J_H, and meet the data through one exchange edge:

 H=Delta P_L+J_H P_HT+g S_3.S_4.                         (1)

Prepared occupations, calibrated exchange values, switching, and loading
the helper singlet are resources. Following a contact, BOTH helper
electrons are removed or replaced; they can carry away angular momentum.
This is a finite unitary contact followed by physical discard, not an
assumed spin-relaxation Lindblad jump. If retained instead, their correlated
state must be tracked and no reset theorem follows by relabelling them as
fresh. Loading can use a double occupation in a single admitted orbital,
whose two-electron ground state is a singlet, followed by separation.
The loading, ramps, isolation, and transport times all enter elapsed time.

The exchange model itself requires ordinary charge and orbital admission.
For a Hubbard realization J approximately 4 t^2/U is a low-energy limit;
finite J/U charge admixture, higher orbitals, valley modes, spin-orbit terms,
and magnetic gradients do not disappear from the physical budget.
